description: Throwaway sourcing probe for the route-span gap (owner question 2026-09-09): route-structures-v1's only road-spanning piece is wrbridgestone01, a 4.216 m slab with no pier, abutment or parapet, which the compiler tiles up to 93 times for a 390 m crossing. This probe measures the candidate SPAN SYSTEMS the vault already holds, so the pick is made on measured geometry and on the authors' own mined co-placement offsets, never on a name: the vanilla Nordic temple exterior platform-tower system (deck, free deck, end cap, two tower heights, parapets, stair run and its caps, shaft base), which the mined assemblies show self-chaining at 5.46 m with a tower every 2.73 m half-module; the Black Marsh & Valenwood hut-exterior timber bridge and its step approaches, which chain at 9.70 m; the vanilla whole-bridge statics in landscape/bridges plus dragonbridge01; and the Imperial fort exterior bridge with its two support pieces. Not a shipping kit.
